## Overview
Chanuka Jeewantha is an international career branding specialist and executive CV / resume writer. Every document is personally written by Chanuka—no junior writers, no outsourcing, and no generic template filling.

Positioning: Executive-grade, personally written by the founder at an accessible premium price ($129 – $400 USD), directly answering complaints in the market about impersonal template mills and unaffordable $2,500 agencies.

## Core Target Markets & Regional Conventions
Chanuka Jeewantha optimizes career documents tailored strictly to the destination country's recruitment norms:
- **United Kingdom (/uk)**: Strictly 2 pages (1 page for graduates), British English, no photos, no personal biodata, right-to-work framing.
- **United States (/usa)**: 1-2 pages strictly, US English, Google XYZ accomplishment formula, Workday/Greenhouse ATS compliance, EEOC no-photo compliance.
- **Australia (/australia)**: 2-3 pages, capability-driven, Key Selection Criteria (KSC) alignment using STAR methodology, Australian English.
- **Canada (/canada)**: 2 pages, Canadian English, human rights code compliance, overcoming the 'Canadian experience' hurdle.
- **New Zealand (/new-zealand)**: 2-3 pages, unpretentious results-driven Kiwi tone, Green List and visa clarity.
- **International Corridors (/international-job-seekers)**: Relocation job search for UK, UAE, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Singapore.
